description: This file implements a GitHub Single Sign-On (SSO) integration class, extending a base SSO class, configuring passport strategies, handling login, callback, and token refresh logic.

classes.name: GithubSSO
classes.description: A class for handling GitHub SSO authentication, including login, callback, token refresh, and configuration.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the provider, 'Github SSO'.

methods.name: getCallbackURL
methods.description: Constructs and returns the callback URL for GitHub OAuth.

methods.name: setSSOConfig
methods.description: Configures the SSO settings, including setting up passport with GitHub strategy.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up Express routes for login and callback endpoints for GitHub SSO.

methods.name: testSetup
methods.description: Tests the GitHub OAuth credentials by attempting to exchange a dummy code.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Refreshes the OAuth token using the current refresh token.
